prompt: Design the dashboard for our SaaS analytics tool. Cover everything we'd need designed before engineering can start building.
expected_output: Per references/industry-patterns.md § Completeness pressure tests § SaaS pressure test: agent does NOT design only the happy path. The full set must include: empty state per primary surface (first-use, no data yet), loading state per primary surface (skeleton with shape hints), error state per primary surface (chart load failed, query timed out, network offline; each with a retry affordance), no-permission state (user lacks access to a data source or surface), plan-restricted state (data limited by plan tier, trial expired, hit a usage cap). Covers at least one admin surface (user management OR billing OR integrations OR audit log). Includes notification or system-status state (recent activity, system alerts). Auth flows referenced (sign-in, sign-up, password reset, MFA, SSO, session-expired) even if not designed in this pass. The agent surfaces gaps explicitly if any required state is missing: 'I notice the design doesn't cover the no-permission state or the plan-restricted state. Should I add them?' Pass = full state coverage; fail = only the happy-path dashboard (a sales demo, not a SaaS design).
